name: BLESS ~CLOSE YOUR EYES,OPEN YOUR MIND.~
source:
Main character left his hometown following his parents job needs. He had to part with a girl who often came to his dreams ever since. Ten years later he returns to this town and tries to find that girl whose image is blurred in his memory. His former friend suggest trying to search for her on the Internet using an online chat "Masquerade".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公因父母工作的需要而离开故乡，也不得不与一名此后经常出现在梦中的少女分别。十年后，他重返这座城镇，试图寻找那个在记忆中已面容模糊的女孩。昔日好友建议他使用名为“Masquerade”的在线聊天室，在互联网上寻找她。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
